events.comment: BOUNCE BACK - all tuning numbers are scene variables (1 Unity unit = 64 px). Esc goes back to the menu.
M1 Ball controller: speed up over time and keep rolling right. Camera follows sideways.
M2 Level generator: one floor segment per frame until the floor reaches SpawnAhead past the ball. First SafeSegments are hazard-free with no gaps.
M2 Cleanup: delete level pieces far behind the ball.
M3 Hotbar: 1/2/3 select, R flips the ramp, left click places the selected item at the mouse (if off cooldown).
M3 Items vanish ItemLifetime seconds after being placed.
M3 Trampoline: launch the ball upward at BounceSpeed on every hit.
M4 Score = furthest distance in metres (Unity units).
Death: spikes, hazard walls, or falling below DeathY.

parameters: "Distance: " + ToString(Score) + " m" + NewLine() + "Best: " + ToString(Best) + " m" + NewLine() + NewLine() + "Press Space to bounce back"

events.comment: Space restarts after dying. Esc returns to the menu any time.
Title screen. Art slots: put your own backdrop art on the Backdrop layer (sky, fog, skyline); swap the placeholder shapes for your sprites.
The ball bounces forever on the trampoline: bounce back!
Layout: centre the UI texts and pulse the prompt.
Menu input: Space or 1 starts, 2 shows controls, 3 shows credits, Esc closes a panel.

parameters: "CONTROLS" + NewLine() + NewLine() + "1 / 2 / 3  -  Select Trampoline / Ramp / Wall" + NewLine() + "Left click  -  Place selected item at the mouse" + NewLine() + "R  -  Flip the ramp direction" + NewLine() + "Space (after dying)  -  Restart" + NewLine() + "Esc  -  Back to this menu" + NewLine() + NewLine() + "Press 2 or Esc to go back"
"CREDITS" + NewLine() + NewLine() + "(your team writes this)" + NewLine() + NewLine() + "Press 3 or Esc to go back"
